<thought>Using the valid functional group names, search for retrosynthetic templates that break a ketone and a C‑C triple bond and form a C‑C double bond (alkene), which matches the described cycloaddition transformation.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C triple bonds"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
  "bonds_formed": ["C-C"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
